gameDescriptionHtml:
Mario vs. Donkey Kong centers around the timeless rivalry between Mario and Donkey Kong, showcasing the best traits of both characters through clever and challenging levels. Players guide Mario through various stages, tasked with solving puzzles and overcoming obstacles to rescue Mini-Marios from Donkey Kong’s clutches. Each subsequent game introduces new elements and mechanics, such as unique abilities and tools, to aid Mario in his mission. Mario vs. Donkey Kong games offer an engaging and memorable gaming experience that emphasizes strategic thinking and quick reflexes, while also providing nostalgic enjoyment for fans of both Mario and Donkey Kong.

Game features:

  • Jump and climb your way through over 130 puzzling levels as Mario to retrieve the Mini-Marios stolen by Donkey Kong
  • Overcome obstacles like spikes, lava, and falling bricks to make it to the end of each level
  • Revisit the original challenge in Classic Style, or try Casual Style for a more relaxed experience
  • Play through two new worlds, featuring new environments, enemies, and game mechanics
  • Join the action as Toad and work together in the newly-added co-op mode
